hints.title: Greedy Highest Frequency Choice
hints.text: Always try to append the character with the highest remaining count, up to 2 consecutive times.

hints.title: Break Three-in-a-Row
hints.text: If the last two characters in the result are already this character, pick the second most frequent character instead.

hints.title: Termination Condition
hints.text: If the second character also has count zero or is unavailable, no valid character can be appended, so terminate.

complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate repeatedly chooses the dominant character unless blocked by a double repetition.
complexity.notes: No substring of length 3 can contain three identical characters.
